title: Phantasmal Might
wikitext:
{{status | name = Phantasmal Might | type = Buff | description = Your spells deal additional physical damage. }} '''Phantasmal Might''' is a stacking [[buff]] which grants additional [[physical damage]] to [[spell]]s based on the level and number of [[Phantasm]]s the user controls. ==Sources== * {{il|The Black Cane}} * The Black Cane [[Reliquarian]] passive in [[version 3.29.0]] ==Mechanics== The amount of physical damage added scales with the level of each Phantasm owned. Phantasm level is based on the skill/gem level of the source that summoned it. When {{il|Soulwrest}}'s {{sl|Summon Phantasm}} and {{il|Summon Phantasm Support}} are linked, Phantasms summoned through corpse consumption will inherit the support's maximum Phantasm count and both Summon Phantasm contribute to Phantasmal Might based on the numerical values corresponding to their respective levels. Lv25 from Soulwrest and Lv21 from support gem combine for a total of min 44+48 and max 66+74, granting 92–140 added spell physical damage per summoned Phantasm.(v3.29 Reliquarian only) :Note: it is not recommended to simultaneously link the Summon Phantasm Support to any non-Summon Phantasm skill that can deal [[damage]] or [[cull]]; if it does, it will activate the support's stat condition and summon a Phantasm based on the support gem, with the maximum minion count and stats limited to what is listed on the support gem. Multiple sources of the Phantasmal Might buff do not stack. Due to Phantasms having very low life, it is recommended to use {{psl|Blessed Rebirth}} and/or {{psl|Prolonged Servitude}} to increase their uptime. ===Maximum added damage=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
